title: Release of ChatGPT
summary: OpenAI released ChatGPT, a generative AI chatbot using GPT-3.5, to the public on 30 November 2022 as a free research preview. It attracted 1 million users within five days, according to OpenAI's chief executive Sam Altman. According to the investment bank UBS, its growth set the record for the fastest-growing consumer app in history, with analysts there estimating 100 million monthly users in January 2023, roughly two months after release.

uncertainty.note: Release date is consistently reported as 30 November 2022 across sources.

where.modern_name: San Francisco, California, United States (proxy pin at OpenAI's headquarters, Wikidata P159/P625; ChatGPT was released online)

importance.justification: According to UBS, ChatGPT set the record for the fastest-growing consumer app in history, and HISTORY.com reports that it has shaken up fields including education, computer science, law and management consulting.
